按参考图保留“福善寺”的标注，寺院位于古塔南侧。公开地图写作“福山寺”，名称及现: This map follows the illustrated guide’s label for Fushan Temple, south of the pagoda. Public maps use a different Chinese character for “shan”; the name and site access still need confirming. The architecture walk here is an example.
对应参考图西北侧的游客中心建筑组团。现场服务内容、入口和开放时间请以景区公告为准: This is the visitor centre complex in the northwest of the illustrated map. Check park notices for entrances, services and opening times.
以水为幕，以戏为引。跟随清婉曲声，走进一段水乡故事。可以提前到河岸边，找一个适合: With the water as a backdrop, follow the gentle melody into a canal-town story. Come early to find a good listening spot along the bank.
让指尖，记住一座城: Get to know the town through your fingertips
从一根丝线开始，认识传统织造的细密与耐心。体验简单织作，感受濮院与丝绸之间的故事: Start with a single thread and discover the patience of traditional weaving. Try a simple weave and learn how silk shaped Puyuan.
一方舞台，一段旧梦: One stage and a dream from long ago
在剧场中听一段江南小调，跟随曲词和身段走入故事。节目为交互演示内容，真实演出以园: Listen to a Jiangnan folk tune and follow the performers’ words and gestures into the story. This is a sample programme; check park notices for actual performances.
好物有来处，生活有诗意: Every handmade piece has a story
逛一逛古镇的风物小集，看看器物、织品和手作。用一段没有目的的散步，发现旅途的小惊: Browse crafts, textiles and household wares at the old town market. Leave room for a little discovery as you wander the lanes.

从飞檐到院落，从石桥到水巷，用散步的速度观察古镇。这里提供一个古建主题漫游内容示: Look up at the eaves and into the courtyards as you walk from stone bridges to narrow canals. This sample architecture walk is not a scheduled guided tour.
一盏清茶，半日江南: A pot of tea and an afternoon in Jiangnan
倚窗临水，慢饮一盏。茶点与热茶相伴，给游园留一段松弛的时光。: Take a window seat by the water for hot tea and small pastries. Leave a little time in your day to linger.
寻常烟火，也有江南滋味: Everyday cooking with a taste of Jiangnan
以家常水乡风味为灵感的餐厅示例。小炒、汤羹和时令菜，适合走累后慢慢吃一餐。: A sample restaurant inspired by canal-town home cooking. Sit down to stir-fries, soups and seasonal vegetables after a long walk.
热气升起来，旅途慢下来: A steaming bowl and a slower pace
清汤一碗，浇头几味。在古镇街巷中，用一碗热面补充散步的能量。: A clear broth and a choice of toppings make a bowl of hot noodles just the thing to fuel another walk through town.
把一点甜，留在旅途中: A sweet stop along the way
